author: agileacademyinsights
desc: Elon Musk is basically telling his competitors: Go ahead. Copy our rockets. In this interview, Musk says SpaceX doesn't use patents to stop competitors from copying its technology. There's even a rocket outside the company's headquarters that anyone can inspect. Whether copying a rocket is quite that simple is another question. But the leadership question goes beyond protecting a design. Competitors can study a product, understand the technology and hire experienced engineers. Reproducing the way an organization keeps improving is much harder. How do people solve problems together? How quickly can they make decisions? Can teams experiment, learn from failures and apply what they discover? At Agile Academy, we believe those capabilities deserve as much attention as the products they help create. Protecting what a company has already built is only part of the work. Leaders also need to make sure their teams can build what comes next. Catching up with a product is one thing. Catching up with a company that keeps learning and improving is another. Source: Elon Musk, The New York Times DealBook Summit, November 18, 2026. #Leadership #Competition #Innovation

author: jaxdecon
desc: Trigger warning: blood and biohazard cleanup footage. Where do you start when an accident leaves a hotel room covered in biohazard contamination? Thankfully, this person survived and emergency services were able to help. While they’re recovering, I’m stepping into the room for the next six, seven, maybe eight hours to work through the cleanup. This is another side of crime scene cleanup: responding to accidents and medical emergencies that leave behind blood and contaminated materials. Hotel biohazard cleanup doesn’t always involve a crime, but it still requires careful work. The first step on this job is identifying the main source of contamination. Here, that’s the bed. The room might look overwhelming, but having a starting point turns that scene into a process. We begin with bulk removal: removing contaminated bedding and other affected materials, packing the waste into red biohazard bags and boxes, and working through what needs to come out. This is the part of blood cleanup that happens before we can address the surfaces and contamination underneath. Bagging everything up isn’t the end of the job, either. The biohazard waste from this cleanup goes to a dedicated facility for proper disposal. I’m sharing the work behind hotel accident cleanup—from that first walkthrough to removing the biggest source of biohazard. Every room has a different situation, and behind every cleanup is a person whose life was interrupted. Follow Jax Decon for a firsthand look at crime scene cleanup, blood cleanup, and biohazard remediation in Jacksonville, Florida. What would you tackle first walking into this room? #BiohazardCleanup #CrimeSceneCleanup #904

desc: The $30,000 computer that runs Wall Street 🖥️ The Bloomberg Terminal is the most important machine in finance. It has black screens, orange text and a keyboard with yellow, red and a green "GO" key, and it costs around $30,000 a year per user. More than 300,000 traders, bankers and fund managers pay for it to see every stock, bond and currency in real time, and to chat with each other on its built-in messaging system. It was created by Michael Bloomberg after Salomon Brothers pushed him out in 1981 with about $10 million from his partnership stake. His first customer was Merrill Lynch. Today the terminal brings in more than 85% of Bloomberg L.P.'s revenue and made him one of the richest people in the world. Follow for more finance explained in under a minute. #bloomberg #wallstreet #finance #investing #money

desc: Max Did Not Expect Ray To Become A Diva! 💅😭 #clips #tiktok #fyp #fypシ #fypシ゚viral #viral_video #viralnow #trending #usa #funny #meme #plaqueboymax #rayasianboy  During a school exchange trip to Japan in July 2023, Ray learned that Kai was broadcasting nearby and followed clues from the livestream to a 7-Eleven, where he approached him. Their encounter was captured on the stream and circulated online. Kai later visited Taiwan for Ray's high-school graduation in 2024 and invited him to the United States. Ray subsequently created content with Kai and other members of AMP. At the 2024 Streamer Awards, Ray was nominated for Best Breakout Streamer. In March 2025, Ray appeared in the GQ Sports video series 10 Essentials. The Central News Agency reported that the video reached number five on YouTube's United States trending list within seven hours of publication. In June 2025, Ray played in a creator charity basketball game in Houston. He made four three-point shots during the game, including one from near midcourt. In October 2025, GQ Taiwan published what it described as Ray's first exclusive magazine interview. In the interview, Ray said that his time with Kai and other AMP members had shown him how successful creators handled their careers and had helped him remain grounded.

author: clipcurrentdaily
desc: This video features a street-level interview conducted during a public gathering, capturing an independent reporter engaging with a rally attendee regarding current social definitions. The interviewer initiates the conversation using progressive terminology to ask about a personal transition, which immediately leads to an argument-driven misunderstanding when the interviewee clarifies her status as a biological woman. The ensuing dialogue highlights a clear breakdown in communication as both parties attempt to navigate assumptions and circular definitions within public discourse. By documenting this specific interaction, the clip serves as a cultural analysis of how contemporary social jargon can create friction and confusion in everyday public settings. The conversation illustrates the ongoing societal debate regarding standard social definitions versus subjective interpretations of identity. Ultimately, the video frames the encounter as a direct reflection of the challenges present in modern ideological dialogue. #CultureWar #PublicDiscourse #IdentityPolitics #StreetInterview #ConservativePerspective #SocialCommentary #commonsense

author: quanillionaire
desc: This hilarious moment features former UFC champion Quinton Jackson when he misunderstands the phrase "gated community" and initially interprets it as "gay community." In the clip, he sees the sign and pauses with a genuinely puzzled expression, clearly trying to process what he thinks he just read. Instead of recognizing it as a normal real-estate term describing a secured residential area with controlled access, he assumes it is referring to a type of community of people, which completely shifts the meaning in his mind. The humor comes from that immediate mismatch between his interpretation and the actual meaning. While the audience instantly understands "gated community," he treats it like unfamiliar or oddly labeled social terminology, which makes his reaction feel both serious and unintentionally funny. His facial expression and tone add to the effect because he isn't joking-he's genuinely trying to make sense of it in real time, which amplifies the confusion. #fypシ #fypシ゚viral #quanillionaire
stickers: The level of misunderstanding is outmatched  😂

author: realraywilliam
desc: Bunch of weirdass people 😑 - - The Laverne Pavlinac story is a bizarre case of a false confession that derailed a murder investigation and allowed a serial killer to remain free. In 1990, following the murder of 23-year-old Taunja Bennett in Portland, Oregon, 57-year-old Pavlinac concocted a detailed lie to frame her abusive boyfriend, John Sosnovske, as a desperate way to get him out of her life. She eventually implicated herself as an accomplice, leading to both of them being convicted and sentenced to life in prison in 1991, despite Pavlinac recanting her story at trial. Because police closed the case based on her fabrications, the real perpetrator—the notorious "Happy Face Killer" Keith Hunter Jesperson- went undetected and murdered at least seven more women over the next several years.

author: bycoastra
desc: Kevin Garnett played basketball with an intensity that was impossible to ignore. From entering the NBA straight out of high school in 1995 to becoming an MVP in Minnesota and an NBA champion in Boston, Garnett gave everything he had to the game. The emotion, the passion, and the competitiveness became part of his identity. But behind that intensity was a person who didn’t always feel comfortable letting others see what he was feeling. There’s something interesting about that contrast. Sometimes the people who appear the toughest are the ones who have learned to keep the most to themselves. And maybe strength isn’t always about how well you hide what you’re feeling. Sometimes it’s being comfortable enough to let people see it. ⚓️ - ➸ Curious how these edits come together? author: eliteathletesdevelopment
desc: Football performance isn't just about how quickly you move. It's also about how quickly you recognise what is happening around you. Before kick-off, RC Strasbourg's Martial Godo incorporates visual activation into his warm-up, preparing his eyes and brain for the perceptual demands of competition. Football is an environment of constant information processing. Every movement requires players to detect relevant cues, interpret what they mean and organise an appropriate response, often within fractions of a second. For an attacking player like Godo, this might involve recognising a defender's body orientation, identifying space to accelerate into, anticipating an opponent's movement or adjusting his actions based on the position of teammates. This is where the relationship between perception and action becomes so important. Visual activation exercises aim to prepare aspects of visual attention, tracking and responsiveness before entering the unpredictable environment of a match. However, effective visual performance isn't simply about seeing more or reacting faster to an isolated stimulus. It's about identifying the right information at the right time and using it to guide football-specific decisions. That's an important distinction. While isolated visual exercises can form part of a pre-match routine, their direct transfer to match performance isn't guaranteed. Scanning, anticipation and decision-making must also be developed through representative football situations where perception and movement are closely connected. Physical preparation gets the body ready to perform. Perceptual preparation considers the information that guides those movements. Because being physically ready means very little if you're consistently late to recognise what's happening around you.
stickers:
MARTIAL GODO’S UNIQUE
WARM-UP ROUTINE👀 preparing his brain to recognise visual cues and respond to the rapidly changing demands of football.

author: clipvault_tjr
desc: GTA 6 road rage is more realistic than my city 🚗 YourRAGE #yourrage #gta6 #fyp #viral GTA 6 is finally here. After two delays and more than a decade of waiting since GTA 5, Grand Theft Auto VI dropped on November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it's already on track to be the biggest launch in gaming history. GTA 5 set the record back in 2013 with 11.2 million copies sold in 24 hours, and analysts expect GTA 6 to sell somewhere between 37 and 51 million copies in its first week. This time Rockstar took the series back to Vice City, but it's only one part of the map. The whole game is set in Leonida, their version of Florida, with the Leonida Keys, the Grassrivers swamps, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and the Mount Kalaga wilderness up north. You play as Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, two criminals whose heist goes wrong and pulls them into a conspiracy that spreads across the whole state. Everyone's streaming it right now and the reactions have been insane. Which part of the map are you going to first, and is GTA 6 living up to the hype for you? Brothers (2009), directed by Jim Sheridan, is a powerful drama about family, war, and the scars it leaves behind. It tells the story of a soldier presumed dead, whose return home unravels deep emotional conflicts within his family. The film explores love, loyalty, and the trauma of war with a raw and intimate approach. Tobey Maguire delivers one of the most intense performances of his career, portraying a man broken by his experiences. His emotional outbursts are so raw and terrifying that Natalie Portman, who plays his wife, was genuinely shaken during filming. The realism of his acting adds a chilling edge to the story, making Brothers not just a family drama but a deeply unsettling portrait of trauma and its impact on relationships. #tobeymaguire #natalieportman #jakegyllenhaal #brothersmovie

author: the.white.bill
desc: Kai Schwemmer Debates Religious Bias in Modern Politics  During a Turning Point USA campus event, speaker Kai Schwemmer engaged in a debate with an attendee over the difference between questioning a politician's motivations and engaging in religious bigotry. Schwemmer referenced historical skepticism surrounding John F. Kennedy's Catholicism during the 1960 election to argue that scrutinizing potential loyalties is a normal part of political inquiry. When the attendee equated those historical concerns with modern bigotry, Schwemmer cited his own Mormon faith and the scrutiny Mitt Romney faced to emphasize that he understands religious prejudice firsthand.   ​This exchange highlights an important tension in American political discourse regarding how voters evaluate candidates' values without crossing into discrimination. In contemporary debates, accusations of bigotry are frequently used to shut down legitimate questions about ideological influence and political allegiances. Distinguishing between unfair prejudice against an identity group and valid scrutiny of an individual's motivations remains essential for preserving open public debate.   ​The discussion reflects Turning Point USA's broader mission of fostering rigorous, unscripted dialogue on college campuses where conservative viewpoints are often challenged. Through direct exchanges like this one, speakers encourage students and faculty to examine historical precedents and apply consistent standards to political arguments. Ultimately, the clip underscores the ongoing conservative emphasis on free inquiry and intellectual honesty in modern American politics.   ​ ​#KaiSchwemmer #TPUSA #FreeSpeech #CampusDebate #PoliticalDiscourse

desc: Why are digital currencies easier to move? ₿ Billionaire Investor Michael Saylor explains that physical assets are difficult to transport at scale. Try moving $1M in cash through an airport, or carrying the same value in gold, and suddenly ownership becomes complicated. His argument is that Bitcoin is different. That portability is one of the reasons he believes digital currencies change the game. #bitcoin #ai #money #investment

author: benkaluza
desc: Match Cut Tutorial using @googlegemini. Prompt below.  Act as a master cinematographer and expert AI image prompt engineer. Your task is to write 20 extremely detailed, hyper-realistic image generation prompts designed to look like candid, documentary-style photographs. They should be at least 500 characters. Core Requirements: 1. Target Text: Integrate the text "[INSERT YOUR TEXT HERE]" naturally into each scene (e.g., on screens, paper, walls, signs, labels). 2. Composition: Every prompt MUST include the exact phrase: "Match the reference image for text placement." Describe a composition where the target text is dead-center, perfectly framed, and the undeniable focal point of the image. 3. Technical Details: Include specific camera equipment (e.g., ARRI Alexa, Sony A7S III, Fujifilm GFX), focal length, aperture (f-stop), shutter speed, and ISO. 4. Realism & Lighting: Specify the lighting setup (practical, ambient, harsh, neon). Describe deep material textures and real-world imperfections (dust, fingerprint smudges, scratches, film grain, screen glare, wear and tear) so the image does not look AI-generated. 5. Aspect ratio: 9:16 Keep the tone professional, using high-level photography direction.  Ensure each of the 20 prompts features a completely different environment and surface for the text. #videoediting #videoeditingtips

desc: Adobe just stepped up their game with a whole load of new features and updates. We’re now beginning to see what the future of professional creative tools looks like. And it’s not just about one-click generative tricks.  It’s about embedding AI as a dependable, everyday partner across a creatives entire workflow. My video covers features that show Adobe is leaning into this balance: - Firefly Boards now let you brainstorm and mood-board in one place. - Firefly Image 5 pushes realism while staying commercially safe. - Harmonize matches any dropped-in image to your scene instantly. - Light Touch lets you relight photos after they’re taken. - Trace Erase removes objects and shadows cleanly. - Photoshop now includes Topaz Labs upscaling natively. - You’ll soon be able to analyse your footage and auto-layer sound effects and split audio into separate tracks. - Project Graph hints at the future: node-based, reusable workflows that link prompts, images and video end-to-end. The decisions Adobe makes now will define their trajectory, especially with more competition than ever. However, if these updates are a sign of what’s coming, they’ll remain the gold standard for creative professionals for a long time. Which feature are you looking forward to trying the most? #adobepartner

Gail is now married and has become the face of a national Alzheimer's campaign — and she says she has most of her memory back. This story will give you chills. 👇 Watch the full story on ksat.com

author: itsgoneviral
desc: Our neighbour kept using our driveway like it belonged to them 😡 They blocked us in, ignored every warning and acted like we were the problem for asking them to move. Even when we made it clear they had no right to park there, they kept pushing their luck. Then one day, they tried it again and walked straight into the savage karma they had been asking for… 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: He thought he could treat me however he wanted and walk away without consequences 😡 The lies, disrespect and completely unacceptable behaviour had already gone too far, but his final mistake gave me all the proof I needed. Now I’m taking everything straight to his boss. He has no idea what is coming, but after what he did, I’m getting him fired… 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: Someone kept leaving mysterious gifts for my child, but nobody knew who they were from 😳 At first, we thought it was harmless. Then the gifts became more personal, started appearing closer to our home and included details only someone watching us would know. When I finally set up a camera to catch them, the person leaving the gifts was the last person I expected… 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: The cop thought his badge meant he could do whatever he wanted… until he stopped the wrong person 😳 What started as a routine encounter quickly turned into threats, false accusations and a serious abuse of power. He refused to listen, ignored the evidence and kept pushing, convinced nobody would challenge him. But the person he was targeting knew their rights, had proof and was not backing down. By the time the truth came out, the officer realised he had made a mistake that could cost him everything… 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: Mother in law bans home birth 😳 I had carefully planned a peaceful home birth… until my mother-in-law decided she had the final say 😳 She criticised every choice, ignored my boundaries and tried to take control of the birth plan as though it was her decision. Then she went one step further and announced that the home birth was not happening. What she did not expect was for the rest of the family to finally see how controlling she had become… and this time, I was not backing down 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: Landlord's mistakes cost me everything 😡 I trusted my landlord to handle the problems with the property… but their mistakes ended up costing me everything 😡 At first, it was missed repairs, ignored messages and promises that never went anywhere. Then the damage got worse, my belongings were ruined, and I was left dealing with bills I never should have had to pay. The landlord tried to blame me, but the evidence told a very different story. By the time the truth came out, I had already lost far more than just my home… 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: HOA neighbor regrets messing with builders 😳 Our HOA neighbour thought they could bully the builders working on our property… but they picked the wrong people to mess with 😳 It started with complaints, demands and constant attempts to stop the work. Then they crossed the line by threatening the crew and interfering with the job. What they did not realise was that the builders had seen everything, kept the evidence and were not about to be pushed around. By the time the neighbour realised their mistake, it was already too late… 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: HOA fued destroys new driveway 😳 We had barely finished our brand-new driveway when the HOA feud turned nasty 😳 What started as a petty complaint quickly spiralled into warning letters, threats and neighbours acting like they had control over our property. Then, one morning, we woke up to find the new driveway completely ruined. They thought they could scare us into backing down, but they left behind more evidence than they realised. So we started digging into what really happened… and uncovered just how far they were willing to go 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: My crazy neighbor went too far... My neighbour had always been difficult, but this time they went way too far 😳 It started with petty complaints, constant interference and watching everything we did. Then the accusations began, followed by threats and behaviour that made us feel uncomfortable in our own home. I tried to ignore it, hoping they would eventually stop. But when they crossed one final line and dragged my family into it, I knew I had to fight back… 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: Secret tears apart my family 😞 I thought keeping the secret would protect my family, but when the truth finally came out, it destroyed everything 😞 Old lies started unravelling, people I trusted turned against each other, and suddenly every argument from the past made sense. The worst part was realising the secret had been sitting inside our family for years, quietly changing all of us. By the time everyone knew the truth, there was no taking it back… and some relationships may never recover 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: Evil HOA neighbors went too far 😳 Our HOA neighbours had always been controlling, but this time they went way too far 😳 It started with petty complaints about bins, parking and the smallest things they could find. Then came the warning letters, threats and ridiculous demands over what we could do on our own property. But when they crossed a line and targeted my family personally, I stopped playing nice. I gathered the evidence, confronted them and exposed exactly what they had been doing behind everyone’s backs… 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: Neighbor's accustation goes too far... My neighbour accused my tiny dog of attacking her cat… but her story made no sense 😡 At first, I tried to stay calm. My dog had never shown any aggression, there were no witnesses, and the details kept changing every time she told the story. But instead of backing down, she started spreading rumours, demanding money and threatening to report us. Then she took the accusation one step too far… and I realised this was never really about the cat 👀

author: itsgoneviral
desc: She's been at it for months 😡 After moving in and trying to set clear boundaries, he didn’t expect an old “arrangement” to cause this much tension… The neighbour insisted she had a deal with the previous tenant to park there, refusing to accept that things had changed 😳 Others on the street said there’d been confusion since the new move-in, with no one clearly resetting expectations. What should’ve been a quick conversation turned into an ongoing dispute over who actually has the right to use the space. Now it’s no longer just about parking, it’s about ownership, communication, and where old agreements end 😡 This is a Vertical Drama production by The Tradesman, for your entertainment 🎬

author: itsgoneviral
desc: We’ve been going door to door for weeks now… and it’s always the same story 📁 Students insisting they didn’t know, didn’t see the letters, didn’t think it was serious 😳 At first we explained things politely. Then we explained them again. But after a while, all you can really do is log the silence and move things forward Funny thing about unpaid debts like this… they don’t just disappear 😮‍💨 Eventually they get attention whether people want them to or not and one way or another, everything gets settled in the end! Original scripted vertical drama by IGV 🎬 #igv #original #scripteddramaa #tiktokdrama #dramalover #series

author: itsgoneviral
desc: I hired a private investigator and all my suspicions were confirmed... 😡  For a year, she had been watching her husband come home late, catching him in lies about where he had been, and quietly building a picture she desperately hoped was wrong.  When the investigator handed over everything he had found, ten years of marriage came into very sharp focus, and she already had a plan for what came next. 💔⚖️😳  Would you have hired a PI… or confronted him the moment something felt off? This is a Vertical Drama production by Ultimate, for your entertainment 🎬 #igv #original #scripteddramaa #tiktokdrama #dramalover #series

author: itsgoneviral
desc: She's refusing to pay him $20,000... 😳 He had finished the job, sent the invoices, and spent weeks calling with nothing but excuses coming back, until he showed up at her door himself to get answers. She told him her husband handled all the finances, her husband wasn't picking up, and the $20,000 he was owed was going absolutely nowhere. 🔨⚖️😳 Was he right to show up at her door… or should he have let his lawyer handle it from the start? author: beanwizardofficial
desc: A lot of people have been asking how did Justin and I meet? Well, technically, our very first interaction involved him putting an entire apple in his mouth. 😂 I was at summer camp in 2011 doing a volunteer program, and Justin was one of the camp counselors. We had never met before. I walked into the dining hall, and he was sitting at a table right by the door. As I walked in, he randomly told me that he could eat an entire apple in one bite. I’m pretty sure I looked at him like, “Yeah, okay…” 😂 So naturally, he had to prove it. This man proceeded to shove the ENTIRE apple into his mouth and eat the whole thing. And I absolutely DIED laughing. That was literally our first interaction. Not a “Hi, I’m Justin.” Not a normal introduction. Just Justin eating an entire apple in one bite. 😂 And somehow… that was the beginning of our story. From 2011 to 2013, we became really good friends. He was one of those people I always wanted to be around because he was just so funny. He had a way of making me laugh and smile no matter what, and I genuinely loved spending time with him. Looking back, I think that friendship was such an important part of our story because I got to know him for who he really was before we ever started dating. Then, in 2013, we started dating. But our story didn’t go exactly as planned. We eventually broke up, went our separate ways, and lived completely different lives for several years. Then, somehow, in 2020, our paths crossed again and we found our way back to each other. And this time, we knew. We got back together in 2020 and got married that same year. We’ve been together ever since. 🤍 Looking back, it’s crazy to think that the random girl walking into a dining hall in 2011 had absolutely no idea that the goofy guy sitting by the door would one day become her husband. We’ve known each other for 15 years, and our story has had its twists, turns, time apart, and second chances. But I truly believe everything happened exactly when it was supposed to. Sometimes the person you’re meant to spend your life with isn’t someone you meet once and immediately get it right with. Sometimes you have to grow, go your separate ways, and find your way back to each other. And somehow, it all started with an apple. 🍎😂 #howwemet #ourstory #marriage #bestfriend #iloveyou

author: beanwizardofficial
desc: After sharing a really vulnerable video about Justin, we were a little nervous putting that out there. But the amount of love, kindness, prayers, and support that has come in from you all... it's overwhelming in the best way. Every message, every comment, every bit of encouragement has meant more than you probably realize. Even though we can't reply to everyone, please know we have read every single message, and we feel it all. You guys didn't just watch, you showed up for us, and that's something we'll never take for granted. We're taking the time we need right now, but we may still share things here and there, just not our usual content, and only when we feel ready. Please know you've lifted his spirit more than you know. Truly. Thank you for loving us like this.🤍

desc: The French winger revealed he rejected an offer to sell the rights to HELIOS, the strategy card game he launched in 2022 after spending around two and a half years developing it. The idea actually started from wanting something to play with his children. desc: 🔴 Terremotos en Venezuela dejan más de 164 muertos y unos 1,000 heridos mientras el país declara emergencia. Dos fuertes sismos sacudieron al país el miércoles. Se espera que la cifra de víctimas aumente debido a los extensos daños.  La presidenta en funciones, Delcy Rodríguez, declaró el estado de emergencia y anunció por televisión estatal el cierre del aeropuerto de Caracas, la suspensión de los servicios ferroviarios y la cancelación de las clases. Mientras continúan las labores de rescate, Estados Unidos anunció un despliegue “inmediato equipos de búsqueda y rescate, recursos médicos y asistencia humanitaria”.

author: spinningtoptom
desc: Spinning tops are one of the oldest toys ever discovered. Archaeologists have found tops dating back thousands of years in places like Ancient Egypt, Greece, Rome, China, and Japan. Long before screens, engines, or electricity, people were fascinated by the simple act of making an object spin. I've been collecting modern spinning tops for about 8 years now, and these are some of my favourites: 1. Edge Industries (One of a Kind)    A completely unique piece. There is only one like it in the world. 2. BilletSPIN K2 (Production)    One of the most iconic production tops ever made and a favourite among many collectors. 3. Spin in Style (One of a Kind)    A handmade custom piece from one of the hobby's most respected makers. 4. AMW (One of a Kind)    A rare custom top from a maker known for producing highly collectible pieces in very limited numbers. 5. Clockwise Tops (One of a Kind)    One of the standout pieces in my collection and not something you see very often. 6. BilletSPIN Xeno (Production)    A modern design that looks completely different from what most people picture when they think of a spinning top. 7. Jon Sauer Ornamental Top (One of a Kind)    Part spinning top, part artwork. A beautiful example of ornamental turning. 8. Stemless Edge Industries (One of a Kind)    One of the most unusual tops I own. No stem, no handle, just spin. Most people don't even know top collecting exists, but there are makers and collectors all over the world keeping this ancient hobby alive. Which one is your favorite?

author: spinningtoptom
desc: Before there were fidget spinners, smartphones, video games, or even bicycles, people were spinning tops. The spinning top is one of the oldest toys ever discovered. Archaeologists have found examples dating back thousands of years in places like Ancient Egypt, Greece, Rome, China, and Japan. Long before modern entertainment existed, people were fascinated by the simple magic of a spinning object balancing on a single point. What’s interesting is that despite being separated by oceans and centuries, different civilizations all seemed to invent their own version of the spinning top. There is something universally satisfying about watching an object fight against gravity while spinning perfectly still. Wooden tops became especially popular because they were simple to make and durable enough to survive years of play. For generations, children would carve tops from scraps of wood, often making their own rather than buying them. In many parts of the world, top spinning wasn’t just a pastime. It became a competition, with players battling to see whose top could spin the longest or knock opponents out of a marked circle. Even today, most modern spinning tops still follow the same basic principles that have existed for centuries. The materials may have changed, and some tops now cost hundreds of dollars, but the experience remains remarkably similar. A spinning top from 2,000 years ago would still make sense to someone today. I think that’s part of the appeal. In a world full of technology, a spinning top is refreshingly simple. No batteries. No updates. No screen. Just physics, craftsmanship, and the quiet satisfaction of watching something spin. This wooden top is a reminder that sometimes the oldest toys are still some of the most fascinating.

author: spinningtoptom
desc: Maxwell's dynamical top is a mechanical device designed by James Clerk Maxwell in the 19th century to illustrate and study the principles of rotational motion and gyroscopic effects. The top consists of a symmetrical body with a central axis and is mounted in a way that allows it to rotate freely in multiple directions. By spinning the top and observing its motion, Maxwell was able to demonstrate the conservation of angular momentum and the effects of torque on a rotating body. The device was used primarily for educational purposes and research, helping to provide a visual and practical understanding of the dynamics of rotating bodies, which are foundational concepts in classical mechanics. This wooden Maxwell was made by Dr Phil Gandini of Spin in Style

author: thepublictakehq
desc: And look how far we’ve come 💙 John Lewis dedicated his life to fighting for equality, justice, and a future where everyone had a voice. His words and his legacy continue to live on through the generations carrying that fight forward. And seeing historic victories like Jon Ossoff’s win in Georgia, alongside so many other milestones across the country, is a reminder of just how far we’ve come. From Keisha Lance Bottoms becoming the first Black woman elected governor of any state, to Gina Hinojosa becoming Texas’ first Latina governor, to James Talarico helping turn Texas blue for the first time since 1988, history was made in ways that once seemed unimaginable. These victories represent more than just election results. They represent barriers being broken, doors opening for generations to come, and the countless people who fought to make these moments possible. #politics #democrats #edit #viral #fyp

author: deffnotantt
desc: Donald Trump pressured some of America's biggest law firms into pledging $940 MILLION in free legal services. But how did it happen? In 2025, Trump signed executive orders targeting major law firms, threatening their security clearances, federal contracts, and access to government buildings. Rather than fight back, nine firms reached agreements committing hundreds of millions of dollars in pro bono legal services for causes supported by Trump and the firms. But here's the twist: several law firms refused to back down, sued the Trump administration, and won major court rulings. Was this a legitimate use of presidential power, or did Trump use the federal government to pressure private law firms into making deals? Here's the timeline, the history, and why it matters for American democracy and the rule of law. #washingtondc  #TrumpAdministration #PoliticalNews #USPolitics #learnhistoryontiktok
stickers:
THE PRESIDENT 
IS RUNNING A PROTECTION
RACKET

author: m0gg3dx7
desc: Jason Nguyen, aka JasonTheWeen, went from a regular Texas college student to one of the biggest names in streaming. He blew up with chaotic dating streams, IRL content, and his self-roasting humor that people instantly connected with. In 2024, he joined FaZe Clan and made history as the first Asian streamer to hit 100K active Twitch subs. But he didn’t stop there. Jason stepped into mainstream entertainment, appeared on Sidemen’s Inside, dropped viral tracks like “Dep Gai,” and even got into boxing, sparring with big names like KSI. By 2026, he also showed a different side—raising over $170K for cancer research. From trolling online to building a real impact, Jason turned his life into content—and his content into a legacy. #jasontheweenclips #twitchclips #twitchstreamer #trending #streamerclip

author: x3n0nx7
desc: Jason Nguyen, known as JasonTheWeen, has transformed from a Texas college student into a global titan of the streaming world. Rising to prominence through chaotic "dating" content and high-energy IRL streams, Jason leveraged his self-deprecating humor and relatable personality to build a massive, dedicated community. His career reached a fever pitch in 2024 when he joined FaZe Clan, eventually making history as the first Asian creator to surpass 100,000 active Twitch subscribers. Beyond the webcam, Jason has successfully bridged the gap between internet subculture and mainstream entertainment. He proved his versatility by appearing in the Sidemen’s reality show Inside and venturing into the music industry with viral hits like "Dep Gai." By 2026, he further expanded his brand by engaging in high-profile boxing sparring with stars like KSI and raising over $170,000 for cancer research, showcasing a transition from a "troll" persona to a philanthropic leader. Jason’s legacy is defined by his ability to turn his personal life into a compelling, interactive narrative. Whether through music, sports, or charity, he remains a central figure in Gen Z culture, proving that authenticity and relentless consistency are the ultimate keys to modern digital stardom. #jasontheween #twitchclips #twitchstreamer #trending #streamerclips

author: c5news
desc: A Twitch streamer was forced to pay around £9,000 at a restaurant in Tokyo after his viewers placed orders to his table without him knowing. Yesterday, Nicholas "Lacy" Fosco went on his first-ever live stream from Japan with his girlfriend when he accidentally showed the table's digital ordering QR code. Soon after, he was approached by several waiters about ordering massive amounts of food and drinks. Viewers watching had scanned the QR code from their screens and used the restaurant's remote ordering system to spam the table. The waiter explained that the bill was now 1.6 million yen (roughly 12,000 USD). In the video, the streamer explained how he had to pay 12,000 dollars (around £9,000) because the viewers “thought it would be funny.” "That was weird chat," he said dejectedly. “I’ve never seen anything like that.” #5news #twitch #streamer

author: kalvarykooks
desc: Who is @adinross  Adin Ross is an American internet personality and livestreamer known for his energetic content, gaming streams, and high-profile collaborations. He first gained popularity on Twitch through games like NBA 2K and Grand Theft Auto V, quickly amassing a large following thanks to his charisma and interactive style. After being permanently banned from Twitch in 2023 for violating platform rules, Ross transitioned to the streaming platform Kick, where he continued to grow his audience. His influence extends beyond gaming—he has hosted major celebrities, including a widely publicized 2024 livestream with former President Donald Trump, during which Ross gifted Trump a customized Tesla Cybertruck and a Rolex, sparking national headlines and campaign finance discussions. As of March 2025, Ross was reinstated on Twitch, continuing to cement his place as a prominent figure in the digital media landscape.  #viral #foryou #fyp #meme #memes #instagram #funnyvideo #follow #video #tiktok #reels #adinross #twitch #kick #foryoupage #famous #minecraftparkour

author: dishwithdrew
desc: If you’ve ordered a Taco Bell quesadilla you know how hit or miss they can be, which is especially disappointing when you’re spending that much 😵‍💫 Today I’m showing you how I make their quesadillas at home, start to finish!  This is a big one, so I’ve left all the recipes below, be sure to save this so you can come back and reference! ☺️❤️ 1️⃣ Taco Bell's Creamy Jalapeno Sauce Dupe:  🧾 Ingredients 🧾 One 12-ounce jar pickled jalapeño slices (only 7 Tablespoons of puree needed) 1 teaspoon paprika 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1/2 cup mayonnaise (I am using Dukes, of course) 1/2 cup sour cream 👨‍🍳 Instructions 👨‍🍳 1) Add the entire jar of pickled jalapeño slices, including the liquid, to a blender. Blend until completely smooth, scraping down the sides as needed. The mixture should look like a thin, pale green puree with no visible chunks. 2) In a mixing bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, paprika, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, cayenne pepper, and salt. Stir until the mixture is completely smooth and evenly seasoned. 3) Add seven tablespoons of the blended jalapeño puree to the bowl and mix until fully incorporated. Start with seven tablespoons, then taste and add more puree if desired. Adding too much can make the sauce overly vinegary or too spicy, so increase gradually. 4) Transfer the sauce to an airtight container and refrigerate for at least one hour before using. This resting time allows the flavors to fully develop. The sauce will keep in the refrigerator for up to fourteen days. 2️⃣ Taco Bell Grilled Chicken Dupe 🧾 Ingredients 🧾 1/2 cup water 2 teaspoons kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon MSG 2 teaspoons cornstarch 1 teaspoon chili powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 1/2 teaspoon granulated sugar 2 large chicken breasts (about 1 pound total) 1 tablespoon neutral-flavored oil 👨‍🍳 Instructions 👨‍🍳 1) Place one chicken breast flat on a cutting board. Holding it steady with one hand, carefully slice horizontally through the center of the breast to create two thinner, evenly sized chicken fillets. Repeat with the second chicken breast and set the chicken aside while you prepare the marinade. 2) In a medium mixing bowl, combine the water, kosher salt, MSG, cornstarch, chili powder, paprika, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper and sugar. Whisk until thoroughly combined and the cornstarch has dissolved. 3) Add the chicken to the marinade and toss until each piece is evenly coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes. 4) Heat the oil in a medium sauté pan over medium-high heat. Once the pan and oil are hot, add two pieces of chicken, making sure not to overcrowd the pan. 5) Cook the chicken for approximately 3–4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through. Check the thickest part of each piece with an instant-read thermometer to ensure the chicken reaches a safe internal temperature of 165°F. 6) Transfer the cooked chicken to a plate and repeat with the remaining pieces. Allow the chicken to rest for 5–10 minutes before slicing to help retain its juices. 7) Chop the chicken into your desired size and serve warm in tacos, burritos, quesadillas or bowls. Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. #TacoBell #CreamyJalapenoSauce #FastFoodDupe #DishwithDrew #Copycatrecipe

author: thestrictville_
desc: The worse thing that can happen throwing a child up in the air playfully is when a harmless moment suddenly turns into a scary accident. What starts as a fun game filled with laughter can quickly become dangerous if the child slips from someone’s hands, bumps into a ceiling fan, light fixture, or lands awkwardly. Even when adults have good intentions, children are smaller and more fragile than many people realize, which is why rough play can sometimes lead to unexpected injuries in a matter of seconds. One moment everyone is laughing and enjoying themselves, and the next moment panic can set in if something goes wrong. Because children trust the adults holding them, they often don’t realize the risks involved, making it even more important for people to be careful during playful activities. Most of the time, parents and family members are simply trying to make a child smile, but accidents can happen when people get distracted, misjudge their grip, or throw the child higher than intended. A single mistake can result in bruises, broken bones, or other serious injuries that turn a joyful memory into a stressful trip to the hospital. That’s why many safety experts recommend keeping playful activities close to the ground, where kids can still have fun without unnecessary risks. While these accidents are not common, they can happen fast enough that there is little time to react once a child is already in the air. What was meant to be a fun bonding moment can quickly become a lesson in how important it is to balance playfulness with safety, especially when young children are involved. #comedy #jokes #hilarious #memes #funny

author: paralleluniverse.ae
desc: Samuel L. Jackson is the President. He’s driving. And America is under attack. 🇺🇸🔥 Get ready for The Beast, a high-octane action thriller that puts one of Hollywood’s most iconic stars behind the wheel of the most heavily protected vehicle on the planet. When a heavily armed militia launches a coordinated coup across the United States, the President is suddenly cut off from his usual protection and forced into a fight for survival. With his Secret Service agent critically wounded and danger closing in from every direction, there’s only one way forward: get behind the wheel of The Beast. But this isn’t just a presidential limousine. Hidden beneath its legendary armor are classified weapons and highly advanced defensive systems that were never supposed to be revealed. Now, with the country collapsing around him, the President has to learn how to use every secret capability the vehicle has — turning the world’s most protected car into a weapon. And at the center of it all is Samuel L. Jackson, bringing his unmistakable presence to a role that takes the presidential action thriller in an entirely new direction. This is a President who isn’t sitting safely inside a bunker or waiting for someone else to save the day. He’s on the road, under fire, protecting his wounded agent, trying to reach his wife, and fighting to take back the country. Directed by Renny Harlin, the filmmaker behind action classics including Die Hard 2, Cliffhanger, and Deep Blue Sea, The Beast is built around the kind of old-school, practical, high-stakes action that demands to be seen on the biggest screen possible. A presidential coup. A wounded Secret Service agent. A classified armored limousine. An arsenal hidden in plain sight. And Samuel L. Jackson behind the wheel. The Beast brings explosive action, political conspiracy, survival, and one seriously unconventional presidential road trip together in a movie made for action fans and the big screen. 🚨 THE BEAST 🎬 In theaters October 9 ⭐ Starring Samuel L.
